description: Initializer module for the UniversalInit Environment Package, managing environment variable mappings between frameworks and providing interface functions.

methods.name: get_template_path
methods.description: Retrieves the path to a template, likely used for environment variable mappings or configuration.

methods.name: parse_template_file
methods.description: Parses a template file to extract or process environment configurations.

methods.name: map_common_to_framework
methods.description: Converts environment variables from a common format to a specific framework's format.

methods.name: map_framework_to_common
methods.description: Converts environment variables from a specific framework's format to the common format.

methods.name: get_supported_frameworks
methods.description: Returns a list of supported frameworks for environment variable mapping.

methods.name: apply_wildcard_mapping
methods.description: Applies wildcard-based mappings to environment variables, enabling flexible matching.
